errors.evidence: The x-axis displays four discrete categories (4, 16, 64, 256). These are not points on a continuous linear scale; they are distinct labels for the groups of bars.
The blue bar for the rank 16 category is visibly taller than the blue bar for rank 4 (which is at approx. 0.24). The value is closer to 0.25, not 0.23.
The blue bar for the rank 64 category extends visibly above the 0.3 gridline. Its value is approximately 0.35, not 0.31.
The green bar for the rank 64 category has a value of approximately 0.18. The reported value of 0.13 is significantly lower than what is shown in the chart.
